risk_if_not_implemented: Without Control Assurance Automation (CAA) Change Control, automated control assurance results may be manipulated, misattributed or lose integrity, causing misplaced confidence in control effectiveness. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Modification / Loss of System Integrity (R-AM-2), Inability to Demonstrate Due Diligence / Due Care (R-GV-9), Unreliable Assurance / Decision Information (R-GV-10), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9), Technical / Mechanical Failure (MT-10).

compensating_control_1.name: Configuration Change Control
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to govern the technical configuration change control processes.
compensating_control_1.justification: Configuration Change Control (CHG-03) provides configuration hardening and change discipline that compensates for the absence of Control Assurance Automation (CAA) Change Control (CFG-23) by enforcing secure settings and trusted software sources to reduce inherent exposure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Security Impact Analysis for Changes
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to analyze proposed changes for potential security impacts, prior to the implementation of the change.
compensating_control_2.justification: Security Impact Analysis for Changes (CHG-06) provides risk identification and prioritization that compensates for the absence of Control Assurance Automation (CAA) Change Control (CFG-23) by enabling informed decisions about where to focus resources to manage residual exposure. Given the process-oriented nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
